# Renovate

Full rules, evidence and examples: `common/languages/renovate.md`.

- RENOV-01 must: Keep consumer `renovate.json` to `$schema`, an `extends` list of `github>muhlba91/renovate-config` presets, an explicit `enabledManagers` allowlist, and extra `packageRules` or `customManagers` only for real exceptions; put reusable rules into a preset.
  Good: `"extends": ["github>example/renovate-config:default", "github>example/renovate-config:group-go"]` and `"enabledManagers": ["gomod", "github-actions"]`.
  Bad: a 40-line `packageRules` block in the consumer that every repo repeats.
- RENOV-02 prefer: Automerge patch updates everywhere, minor for application and library repos, major only in the tooling repos; never automerge Python minor or major; opt out single packages with a rule.
- RENOV-03 prefer: Label every PR `dependencies` plus `renovate-<type>`; commit types follow COMMIT-04. [tool:renovate]
- RENOV-04 prefer: Write Renovate `description` text in lowercase. Observed: give each non-obvious `packageRule` a one-line `description` stating the intent or constraint.
- RENOV-05 prefer: Track versions that managers cannot see with a `custom.regex` manager keyed on a `# renovate: datasource=<ds> packageName=<name>` comment above the value.
- RENOV-06 prefer: Indent consumer `renovate.json` and preset files with 2 spaces.
